action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that the JavaScript mode in CodeMirror used an
inefficient regular expression. An attacker could possibly use this issue
to cause CodeMirror to consume excessive resources, leading to a denial of
service.
isummary:
CodeMirror could be made to consume excessive resources if it received
specially crafted input.

codemirror-js.description: JavaScript editor interface for code-like content

title: CodeMirror vulnerability
